objective: Test whether request-isolating RMSNormGated plus the FP8 GDN output projection closes the final layer-0 c1/c2 prefill boundary and restores strict output identity.

candidate.scope: Qwen XPU GDN pure-prefill calls with more than one request. Single-request, mixed decode/prefill, decode, and speculative calls retain their natural existing computation.
candidate.implementation: Slice bitwise-exact core_attn_out and z rows at prefill query boundaries, apply the existing RMSNormGated and out_proj modules independently for each request at its natural row count, and concatenate results in scheduler order.
candidate.reason: R90 proved layer-0 qkvz, BA, raw GDN core output, and z are exact across c1/c2 on both ranks; layer-1 inputs differ. Only norm/output projection remains between those boundaries.

fixed_workload.sequence: Run cache-c000 alone at c1, then cache-c000 plus index-c001 at c2 in the same fresh server.

followup_if_pass: Build a non-tracing candidate from the production lineage, add an output-stage dispatch counter, and run repeated c1/c2 plus the full varied-prompt determinism/quality battery before measuring overhead or updating any public result.
followup_if_fail: Preserve the result and separately trace normalized rows versus out_proj rows; do not broaden the candidate.
promotion_boundary: Candidate only. No site, README, headline, protected-speed, recipe-default, or LocalMaxxing authority. This boot contains an earlier GPU reset.
